draft.subject: A hand getting your first Quartz Group project up
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Following up on your rate limits question — as mentioned, API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter, and that ticket is now closed. Happy to revisit it any time.

Since the API work usually sits alongside real work in Wrenfield, the next useful step is one real project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week work? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
